sql_changes: Translated from DuckDB SQL to the Polars LazyFrame API and executed with collect(engine='streaming'); Polars SQL does not cover the unbounded SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () of 02, the COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ...) of 03, or the interval arithmetic against a joined column of 04. Each translation preserves the query: 02 divides by the summed group count instead of a window, 03 counts distinct serial_number under a filter instead of a CASE, 04 uses dt.offset_by('-30d') for INTERVAL 30 DAY, and 05 uses a semi-join because month_end_date is unique per month and so DuckDB's inner join selects the same rows. All five produce values identical to my DuckDB 1.5.5 submission.
